topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Master Harold’s new house, it’s a thing to see, but there’s a trouble in the airing. The old ones, they left their shadows behind, things in the attic. Old pots and rags, mayhaps, or worse, who knows what sorcery they left to stir in the night. I sit by my hearth, thinking on the plow and the soil, the good saints watch over us, but what of the spirits of the old home? The debts they left, not just in gold but in the heart of the house. What if the saints frown on such trespasses? I ought to tell him, warn him, but what words can I find? The earth itself seems uneasy, as if the seeds know something’s amiss. I must speak to the vicar, perhaps a blessing, a prayer, to cleanse what cannot be seen. God willing, the harvest will still be bountiful this year.
